item.title: 1.4 Lateral Inhibition in Spiking Networks
item.description: Lateral Inhibition in Spiking Networks A spiking neuron can already turn accumulated input into a timed event: incoming spikes push its internal state upward, and when enough evidence has arrived, the neuron fires.
